description: Source code for Toyota JZS147 engine configuration in a vehicle engine management system, including engine setup functions, pin configurations, thermistor settings, and engine mode configurations.

methods.name: common2jz
methods.description: Configures common engine parameters for the JZ engine family, including displacement, cylinders, firing order, pin assignments, thermistor setup, and fuel injection parameters.

methods.name: setToyota_jzs147EngineConfiguration
methods.description: Sets specific engine configuration for the Toyota JZS147, including trigger type and mode, and disables SD card usage.

methods.name: setToyota_2jz_vics
methods.description: Configures the engine for VICS (Variable Intake Control System) operation with specific trigger and VVT mode settings.
